classifications.SAFE_TEMPLATE: Bounded neutral high-confidence Research template with valid structure and source-owner trace. Still not a product card.
classifications.NEEDS_REWRITE: Question/options/explanation/reference drift from effective authority or violate structural authoring invariants.
classifications.COURSE_POSITION_ONLY: Effective candidate is project-position material; it may not be neutralized.
classifications.NONCOMPETITIVE_ONLY: Authority is contested, interpretive, historical, application-level, medium confidence, or READY_NONCOMPETITIVE.

checks: candidate_id resolves after all candidate overrides
prototype reference equals effective candidate reference
source contract resolves through effective candidate source_minimum
project position is not relabeled neutral
Research noncompetitive state is not upgraded
correct-index distribution remains 16/16/16/16 without overriding semantic checks
rule: Classification is recomputed by scripts/validate_product_handoff.py; older Wave3j/Wave3m self-audits are inputs/history, not current approval.
